description: NaIn₃S₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.28 Å. There are four inequivalent In sites. In the first In site, In is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing InS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-59°. There are a spread of In-S bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.96 Å. In the second In site, In is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing InS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-59°. There are a spread of In-S bond distances ranging from 2.64-2.77 Å. In the third In site, In is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing InS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 4°. There are two shorter (2.54 Å) and four longer (2.75 Å) In-S bond lengths. In the fourth In site, In is bonded to six S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing InS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are four shorter (2.64 Å) and two longer (2.74 Å) In-S bond lengths. There are five inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four In atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na and three In atoms to form SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₂In₃ square pyramids, corners with five SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNaIn₅ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SNa₂In₃ square pyramid, and edges with four SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the third S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na and three In atoms to form distorted SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNaIn₅ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SNa₂In₃ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNaIn₅ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₂In₃ square pyramids, and edges with three SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 40°. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na and three In atoms to form SNa₂In₃ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₂In₃ square pyramid, corners with six SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent SNaIn₅ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SNa₂In₃ square pyramids, and edges with three SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to one Na and five In atoms to form SNaIn₅ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNaIn₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three equivalent SNaIn₅ octahedra, edges with four equivalent SNa₂In₃ square pyramids, and edges with four SNa₂In₃ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
